title: AI Moderator
description: AI-Moderator is a cutting-edge, high-performance moderation system for Minecraft servers (Paper 1.21+). It combines lightning-fast local heuristic filters with the deep contextual understanding of modern AI models (Gemini, OpenAI, Ollama).

---

## Key Features

- **Actionable AI (Player Requests)**: Players can ask the AI for items, time changes, or commands, which generates an admin approval request (`[APPROVE]` / `[DENY]`).
- **Technical AI**: Admins can use `/aimod techai <prompt>` to let the AI dynamically change configs or execute console commands.
- **Contextual Awareness**: The AI reads the active plugins on your server and uses this knowledge to help players navigate custom menus or server features without revealing the raw plugin list.
- **Multi-Model Support**: Native integrations with Gemini, OpenAI, and Ollama.
- **Customizable Heuristics**: Advanced pre-filtering before passing text to LLMs.
- **Punishment System**: Configurable mute, kick, or ban actions per category.
- **Review System**: GUI and Chat-based review workflows for staff (`/aimod review`).
- **Discord Integration**: Webhook alerts for flagged messages.

---

**"Wait, another chat filter?" 🤨**
Nope. Traditional filters are dumb. They block "beach" because it looks like a bad word, but they miss a player being incredibly toxic without using a single swear word. 

**AI-Moderator is different.** It uses a real brain (LLM) to understand **context, intent, and tone**. It knows the difference between a friendly joke and actual harassment.


---

## Why your staff will love this

###  The "Triage" Logic (Fast & Smart)
We don't waste your money. Every message first hits our **lightning-fast local filter**. 
*   **Safe?** Passes instantly.
*   **Obvious Spam?** Blocked instantly.
*   **Suspicious or Toxic?** Only then we ask the AI for a "second opinion".

### Conversation Memory
The AI doesn't just look at one message. It remembers the **last few things** said in the conversation. It catches players who try to spread their toxicity across multiple messages to bypass filters.

### Automated Justice
Configure your own rules. If a player reaches a certain "Violation Score", the plugin handles the rest:
> **10 pts:** Warning ⚠️
> **20 pts:** 10m Mute 🔇
> **50 pts:** Kick 👢
> **100 pts:** Week-long Ban 🔨
